leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the thirteenth season of , Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the thirteenth season of , Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
Three Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors DVD sets were released in 2012 by VIZ Media and distributed through , containing the whole season between them. Each set contains two discs. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

===Set 1: Episodes 1-11===
 
Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors - Set 1 was released on February 28, 2012. It contains two discs with 11 episodes across them combined.

 
 

===Set 2: Episodes 12-22===
 
Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors - Set 2 was released on May 1, 2012. It contains two discs with 11 episodes across them combined.

 
 

===Set 3: Episodes 23-34===
 
Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors - Set 3 was released on September 4, 2012. It contains two discs with 12 episodes across them combined.

 
 

==The Complete Season==
 
Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors - The Complete Season, referred to as Pokémon The Series Diamond and Pearl: Sinnoh League Victors Complete Season on VIZ Media's website, is a Complete Collection DVD set that was released on February 23, 2021 by VIZ Media and distributed through . This Complete Collection contains four discs with 34 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000084251. It consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover.

 
 
==External links==
